name: grill-me
description: Stress-test a technical plan or design by walking through its decision tree one focused question at a time.

interface.longDescription: Challenge a plan or design iteratively, resolve dependencies between decisions, inspect the codebase when it can answer a question, and provide a recommended answer for each decision.
defaultPrompt: Grill me on this implementation plan.
Challenge this architecture until the important decisions are resolved.
Stress-test this design one question at a time.
